subject: Operations
title: Last-Mile Delivery
description: Learn Last-Mile Delivery in one minute.

hook.text: The last mile of delivery is only 1% of the distance but 53% of the total shipping cost. It's absurdly expensive.

buildup.text: Last-mile delivery moves packages from a local hub to the customer's door—navigating traffic, apartments, and schedules.

discovery.text: Failed deliveries, returns, and re-attempts make the last mile the most complex and costly logistics challenge.

twist.text: Amazon spent billions building its own last-mile fleet because third-party carriers couldn't meet its speed demands.

climax.text: Innovations like lockers, drones, and crowd-sourced drivers aim to cut last-mile costs by 40% or more.

punchline.text: The last mile is the hardest and most expensive.

quiz.question: Why is last-mile delivery so expensive?
options: Complex routing and frequent failed deliveries
